entries.standard: It's been a long time / Long time no see (已为英语习语)
entries.origin: 19世纪中国皮钦英语（洋泾浜），1890年代在美国英语中出现，OED 有记录
entries.example: Hi Bob! Long time no see.

entries.standard: I can't do it / That can't be done
entries.origin: 中国皮钦英语，直译“不能做”，已被英语吸收为习语
entries.example: Sorry, no can do.

entries.standard: to take a look / to inspect
entries.origin: 中国皮钦英语（look 看 + see 见），OED 归源于中国皮钦英语
entries.example: Let's have a look-see at the damage.

entries.origin: 中国皮钦英语（粤语“快快”），已进入英语口语
entries.example: Chop chop! We're going to be late.

entries.standard: to kneel and touch the ground with the forehead
entries.origin: 粤语借词，进入英语已 200 余年，OED 收录
entries.example: He refused to kowtow to authority.

entries.origin: 多源词，其中一路源自粤语/中文“台风”，经皮钦英语进入英语
entries.example: The typhoon made landfall overnight.

entries.standard: to lose face / to be humiliated
entries.origin: 中文“丢面子”直译（calque），已被英语吸收为固定搭配
entries.example: He lost face in front of his colleagues.

entries.origin: 中文“纸老虎”直译，1950年代进入英语，主流词典收录
entries.example: The regime was dismissed as a paper tiger.

entries.origin: “工业合作社”缩略音译，二战期间进入美式英语
entries.example: The whole team is gung-ho about the project.

entries.origin: 中文“洗脑”直译，1950年代经朝鲜战争报道进入英语
entries.example: It sounds like brainwashing.

entries.origin: 中文音译借词，主流英语词典收录
entries.example: He practices kung fu every morning.

entries.origin: 中文音译借词，主流英语词典收录
entries.example: I'll have the mapo tofu.

entries.origin: 中文音译借词，主流英语词典收录
entries.example: They hired a feng shui master.

entries.origin: 中文音译借词，英语媒介报道中国事务时常用
entries.example: In China, guanxi matters a lot in business.

entries.origin: 中文音译借词，主流英语词典收录
entries.example: The grandparents play mahjong every evening.

entries.standard: dim sum (已为英语标准词，粤语借词)
entries.origin: 粤语“点心”音译借词
entries.example: We went for dim sum on Sunday.

entries.origin: 中文音译借词（经粤语），主流英语词典收录
entries.example: Lychees are in season now.

entries.standard: chow mein (已为英语标准词，粤语借词)
entries.origin: 粤语“炒面”音译借词，主流英语词典收录
entries.example: I ordered chicken chow mein.

entries.standard: wonton (已为英语标准词，粤语借词)
entries.origin: 粤语“云吞/馄饨”音译借词
entries.example: A bowl of wonton soup, please.

entries.standard: bok choy (已为英语标准词，粤语借词)
entries.origin: 粤语“白菜”音译借词
entries.example: Stir-fry the bok choy with garlic.

entries.standard: keep going / go for it / come on
entries.origin: 香港英语/中文直译“加油”，2018年前后获主流英语词典收录，用于鼓励
entries.example: Add oil! You can pass the exam.

entries.literal: 人 山 人 海
entries.standard: packed / a sea of people / crowded
entries.origin: 成语字面直译，网络流行梗，海外媒体偶引用
entries.example: During the holiday, the station was people mountain people sea.

entries.chinglish: good good study, day day up
entries.literal: 好好 学习，天天 向上
entries.standard: Study hard and make progress every day
entries.origin: 中文口号“好好学习，天天向上”的直译网络梗
entries.example: Good good study, day day up! (网络流传的直译梗)

entries.chinglish: you can you up, no can no BB
entries.literal: 你 行 你 上，不 行 别 哔哔
entries.origin: 网络流行直译，Urban Dictionary 收录
entries.example: You can you up, no can no BB.

entries.chinglish: give you some color to see see
entries.literal: 给 你 一些 颜色 看 看
entries.standard: Teach you a lesson / I'll show you
entries.origin: “颜色看看”逐字直译网络梗
entries.example: If you keep this up, I'll give you some color to see see.

entries.literal: 马 马 虎 虎
entries.origin: “马马虎虎”逐字直译网络梗
entries.example: How was the movie? Horse horse tiger tiger.

entries.literal: 不 三 不 四
entries.standard: shady / dubious / neither fish nor fowl
entries.origin: “不三不四”逐字直译网络梗
entries.example: He hangs out with no three no four people.

entries.literal: 我们 俩 谁 和 谁
entries.standard: Between us, no need to be so formal
entries.origin: “谁跟谁”逐字直译网络梗
entries.example: Don't mention it — we two who and who!

entries.literal: 开 门 见 山
entries.origin: 成语逐字直译网络梗
entries.example: Let's open door see mountain: the budget is too high.

entries.chinglish: walk one step see one step
entries.literal: 走 一步 看 一步
entries.standard: take it one step at a time / play it by ear
entries.origin: 俗语逐字直译网络梗
entries.example: We'll walk one step see one step.

entries.origin: 数字谐音“溜”，网络流行，直播文化扩散
entries.example: Nice moves — six six six!

entries.standard: a piece of cake / no big deal
entries.origin: “小意思”网络直译，东南亚/中文社区口语
entries.example: This math problem? Small case!

entries.origin: “香蕉人”直译梗，指认同西化的华人（贬义，慎用）
历史标语直译失误，公共标识 Chinglish 经典案例
“小心地滑”逐字直译，断句歧义经典案例
“小心地滑”另一常见误译（词性歧义）
“单行道”字面误译案例

entries.literal: 欢迎 来 参观 再次
entries.standard: Please come again / Hope to see you again
entries.origin: “欢迎再来”直译，海外餐厅/商店常见，已成半可接受表达
